repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbSphdunq2aJq7ktuY

Scope note · 2026-11-19T09:58Z (seat 5's word): #35344 shipped its interim in PR #35428 as LEFT OUT — a `controlled_by_parent` detail's `owner_id` is neither counted nor moved. This card also takes the counted-but-not-moved shape: when an object's switch is off, its `owner_id` rows are counted in the assigned-work answer and shown in the ban-dialog panel as not handed over, with a per-object reason. The panel today words every `transferable: false` row as "lists several people", which is false for an owner column, so the panel must choose its sentence by why a row is not transferable (one new key in each of the seven UI locale catalogues). Pins: a switched-off owner row is counted, never moved, and worded truthfully in en and zh.

repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbSphdunq2aJq7ktuY

Scope note 2 · 2026-11-19T10:09Z (from the contract review of PR #35428, comment 7006025069; carried here on the seat's routing):
- **Optional-master corner (S1 there; PR #35428 fixes only the prose).** On a `controlled_by_parent` detail whose master is optional, a row with an empty master reference is read and written by its owner (ADR-0055 as amended). The #35344 interim leaves its owner out of the hand-over with the rest of the object. This card decides it, either by following the switch as is or by keeping the owner pair for null-master rows only (one pushed-down `IS NULL` conjunct in the same `count` / `find`), and adds a pin: master `required: false` plus a null-master row.
- **N2.** `security.assignedWork.count` in `packages/client/src/index.ts` and `registerUserWorkEndpoints` in `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts` say "the owner field and every app user field". Rewrite both with the count answer.
- **N3.** A counted detail-owner row needs its own reason sentence and must never reuse `console.assignedWork.notTransferable`. That key lives in eleven locale catalogues on main, not seven.

repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbSphdunq2aJq7ktuY

Scope note 3 · 2026-11-19T10:56Z (contract review delta 7007072277 on PR #35428, N5): the `user-assigned-work.ts` docblock lead sentence "On a detail the owner records who did the work, not who holds it" is stated for every detail; a detail with a real owner (a contact under an account) is the case an author switches back on. When this card makes the rule per object, rewrite that sentence with it.
